text:
maria (sec-eng): Heads up — cert-rotator failing in eu-west and ap-south during the scheduled rotation window. Observability missing KMS decrypt events for the rotator SA.

sam (infra): seeing same. TLS handshakes are failing on some proxy pods with cert chain errors. 502s spike.

jin (edge): can confirm frontend edge proxies in eu-west returned 502 -> backend TLS verify failed. stacktrace in proxy logs shows: 
```
verify error: unable to get local issuer certificate
```

nick (devops): any recent RBAC changes? last deploy notes showed we tightened KMS key policy yesterday.

maria (sec-eng): yes — key-policy change to remove broad read for the legacy service account. intended, but looks like the new least-priv SA wasn't propagated to all rotator instances.

ara (compliance): is audit logging showing deny events? we need KMS deny entries for the post-incident audit.

maria (sec-eng): that's the wierd bit — Cloud KMS audit log zeros for decrypt on the key for the last 3h in eu-west. ap-south shows a couple of denies but incomplete. cert-bot tried 15 rotates with no KMS decrypt telemetry.

cert-bot: automated message: cert-rotator job failed 15/15 attempts; fallback disabled.

sam (infra): suspect RBAC changed the IAM/SVC account used by the rotator; containers are still mounting the old SA token until restart — but KMS should still produce audit rows even for unauthorized calls. absence suggests either logs not forwarding or a different key alias used.

jin (edge): I pulled a failing rotator pod and ran `curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health` then `kubectl logs rotator-xyz` — logs show: `decrypt: RPC error: PERMISSION_DENIED` but nothing in cloud audit.

nick (devops): quick mitigation: rotate traffic to standby region where rotator can decrypt (us-east) and enable proxy fallback to the older cert until we resolve. Canary traffic only.

maria (sec-eng): agree for immediate user impact mitigation. add here: revert the key-policy change on the KMS key for 30m to allow rotator to finish rotation run and audit. then re-apply with correct SA grants.

ara (compliance): we prefer writing a temporary exception record before revert. I can create the exception and notify infosec.

sam (infra): doing the rollback of key-policy now, will timestamp and create an approval ticket.

sam (infra): done — policy reverted at 1768345220. rotator attempts resumed.

maria (sec-eng): seeing KMS decrypt events come through now in audit stream. rotator succeeded on eu-west. I triggered a forced rotate for ap-south.

jin (edge): ap-south rotation succeeded. proxies are back to normal. latency normalized.

nick (devops): follow-up actions we should track: 1) update rotator deployment to use the new, scoped SA (and ensure token refresh), 2) add an e2e canary that exercises KMS decrypt, 3) alerting on missing KMS audit events for any key with recent ops.

maria (sec-eng): + add a guard in rotator that checks KMS auditship before committing final chain (fail-open -> fail-safe). i.e., if no decrypt audit event observed, abort and escalate.

ara (compliance): also we need an audit artifact detailing the timeframe and justification for the revert. I'll own the exception record and postmortem checklist.

nick (devops): question for KMS/HSM team: can we get streaming audit delivery (pubsub -> SIEM) for decrypt calls per key so we don't have blind spots during regional IAM policy flips?

maria (sec-eng): good ask. sam, can infra add a SIEM pipeline request and make decrypt logs high priority?

sam (infra): opening infra ticket for audit-pipeline and SLA bump. will include replay window for 24h.

jin (edge): for long-term: replicate key aliases across regions with consistent role bindings, and add a fallback unwrap path (manual HSM admin request with short TTL cert) — documented runbook.

maria (sec-eng): assign owners: rotator code -> nick, RBAC policy sanity checks -> sam, audit streaming -> sam, exception & compliance artifacts -> ara, postmortem write-up -> maria.

nick (devops): I'll push a small rotator patch that rejects rotation until KMS decrypt audit appears in SIEM, and add exponential retry and clearer logs.

maria (sec-eng): thanks. also we should harden TLS profiles: enable stricter cipher lists but keep fallback options for proxies during cert rotation windows. create PR with suggested cipher policy.

ara (compliance): logging requirement: every cert rotation event must include key alias, rotator SA, pod id, and KMS audit entry id. we'll validate in next audit.

sam (infra): noted. I'll attach correlation IDs from the rotation job to the audit events via metadata.

maria (sec-eng): postmortem plan: timeline, cause (RBAC policy change + missing audit visibility), mitigations taken (policy revert + region failover), follow-ups (patch, pipeline, runbook), risk reduction (replication & canaries). I'll draft and circulate.

jin (edge): small nits: add a healthcheck metric that fails if proxy chain verify begins to fail for >5 minutes — too noisy?

maria (sec-eng): not too noisy if we have a suppressed alerting window during planned rotations. otherwise yes. add to runbook.

cert-bot: automated note: incident closed for user-impact at 1768345399. postmortem pending.

ara (compliance): thanks team. will create the exception doc and tag for compliance review.

maria (sec-eng): great job everyone — we'll follow up with the PM and ops on Tuesday for the rollout of the new guardrails.

sam (infra): +1 :thumbsup:

jin (edge): :rocket:

nick (devops): logging a follow-up PR now.

maria (sec-eng): closing thread — keep me in the loop on the PRs and the ticket numbers.
